description: Committee will review a Bird Safe Saskatoon proposal for City Hall.
Proposal seeks up to $5,400 for deterrents and evaluation.

chips.text: Received as information
City Hall is one of Saskatoon's worst buildings for bird collisions.
Taxpayers could fund $50,000 for full north side window treatment.
Toronto's 2007 bird-friendly guidelines inspired similar North American standards.
Bird Safe Saskatoon presented a petition with 500 signatures.
Failure to comply with bird protection laws can result in lawsuits.
Bird collisions kill 16-42 million birds annually in Canada.
City facilities staff committed to installing pilot project materials.

segments.title: Bird Collisions at City Hall
segments.takeaway: Bird Safe Saskatoon presented data on bird collisions at City Hall windows and proposed a pilot project for window mitigation.

segments.title: Budget Options for Window Mitigation
segments.takeaway: Michelle presented cost estimates for different bird deterrent products, including "feather friendly" films and DIY options for City Hall's north side.

segments.title: Committee Questions on Pilot Project
segments.takeaway: Committee members asked questions regarding the pilot project's scope, effectiveness assessment, and the potential for artistic designs on windows.

segments.title: City Staff on Existing Strategies and Budget
segments.takeaway: City staff provided context on existing bird-friendly strategies, mentioned a related project in the upcoming budget deliberations, and discussed scalability.

segments.title: Councillor on Bird Safety Legislation and Funding Offer
segments.takeaway: A councillor highlighted legal responsibilities for bird safety, mentioned Toronto's guidelines, and offered personal funding for Bird Safe Saskatoon's research, also discussing expanding research to

segments.title: Discussion on Bird-Friendly Bylaws and RCE Funding
segments.takeaway: City staff explained that bird-friendly policies are in the Green Pathways plan, and councillors discussed the Reserve for Capital Expenditures (RCE) budget process.

segments.title: Committee Funding Allocation Strategy
segments.takeaway: The committee discussed how their available funds could be used in conjunction with potential city funding, considering options for materials or other bird-friendly work.

segments.title: Bird Safe Saskatoon's Operational Funding Needs
segments.takeaway: Bird Safe Saskatoon explained that additional funds would support a coordinator, public outreach, education events, and social media efforts.

segments.title: Initial Motions and Year-End Budget Deadline
segments.takeaway: The chair proposed motions for a letter of support and funding, noting the committee's remaining budget must be allocated by year-end.

segments.title: Refining Funding Objectives and Request for Proposal
segments.takeaway: The committee refined the funding objectives, deciding to request a detailed proposal from Bird Safe Saskatoon for the use of the remaining funds for bird-friendly actions.
